scope: All four public task descriptions. This is a released subset; the full-suite task denominator is unverified. Published model-run counts do not establish the number of independent tasks.

tasks.assessment: Public task descriptions assessed. Raw biological fixtures, answer vocabularies, grading answers and model trajectories were not inspected for training authoring; input formats include workflow prerequisites requiring schema verification.
required_stages: join RNA cells to sample-specific ATAC fragments
score declared expression programs and chromatin accessibility per replicate
compare locus accessibility, motif or regulator activity and expression across controlled models
test confounding and summarize supported regulatory associations
scientific_decisions: Shared receptor and antigen context does not remove all model confounders; chromatin accessibility and regulator expression are not direct causal activity measurements.
remaining_gaps: Shared receptor and antigen context does not remove all model confounders; chromatin accessibility and regulator expression are not direct causal activity measurements.

Measure a coherent observed subset that preserves replication and the scientific comparison within the 30-minute limit.

required_stages: retain species, embryo, cohort and developmental-stage identity
